photos.c: TOP LEFT: Bill Kerr trails Bullivant and Tulloh on Stage 9. TOP RIGHT: John Thresher hands over to a determined Trevor Hart after stage 2. CENTRE: Alan Mead and 'Noddy' Edwards, with some female assistance, cheer on the runners! BOTTOM LEFT: Laurie O'Hara hands over to Gerry North after chopping 17 secs off the Club record for stage 7. BOTTOM RIGHT: Alan Black brings Belgrave home in 4th place.
Trevor Hart hands over to Charlie Walker with Weatherill (Portsmouth) waiting to take over from the fast-finishing Tulloh.

John Thresher (10) and Geoff. North (9) in the muddy thick-of-it during the Fire Brigade '2' at White City on Sept. 18th. The six runners that surround them are Gibson, Tulloh, Jackson, Stewart, Johnston, and J. Cooke. Geoff. (8:51.0) won from Jackson with John 6th (8:55.4).
